Our products are just the beginning. Clinical expertise, technology and genuine commitment work
together to drive real outcomes for your team.

[Explore Our Products][76][Shop or Rent Products][77][Find Support][78]

efforts, realize staff and task efficiencies, strengthen care coordination and enhance the clinician
and patient experience. Our approach unifies Baxter devices and applications onto one modern
platform, with solutions focused on these areas:

configuration data.

a service catalog — cloud-native and integrated.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI

# Get Exceptional Care of your Children at a top rated Frisco Pediatrician’s Office

Entirely Kids Pediatrics in Frisco, TX, Led by board-certified pediatrician Dr. Danielle Leung,
offers comprehensive pediatric care from infancy to adulthood.

[Make an Appointment][23]

## **Entirely Kids Pediatrics**

Entirely Kids Pediatrics is a Frisco Pediatric practice that is conveniently located at Baylor
Medical Center of Frisco, and we are committed to providing efficient yet thorough, comprehensive
care to children from birth to 18 years of age. Our goal is to provide a comfortable, trusting
environment for both parents and children for all aspects of the child’s primary medical care.
Children are the future of our world, and we want to ensure that they grow up healthy and happy!

Our Pediatrician specializes in helping children with ADHD. We are happy to schedule an appointment
with you to discuss your child and the challenges you are facing.

We strive to be the best pediatrician’s office in Frisco. As a result, we work to give your newborn
and growing children the best pediatric care available, coupled with attentive & caring staff. We
feature a female doctor for parents who prefer to have their daughters visit with a female
pediatrician.
Call us today at **[(469) 425-3600][26]**.

[**Contact Us**][27]

### Newborn Pediatric Care

Selecting the right Frisco pediatrician for your [newborn][28] before you give birth can help
prevent you from being overwhelmed once you bring your baby home from the hospital.

[New Baby Pediatric Care][29]

### Same Day Appointments

We offer same day appointments for sick children at our pediatrician’s office and we keep a few
spots open for same day well visits and immunizations. Call us today.

[Covid-19 Testing][30] & [Telemedicine][31]

### Well Child Visits

We offer appointments for well-child visits and immunizations. Even if your child is healthy, a
well-child visit is a good time to focus on your child’s wellness. Preventative care and exams are
an important part of keeping your child healthy.

[Prenatal pediatric consultations in Frisco TX with Dr. Danielle Leung for expectant parents]

## Meet the Doctors

Dr. Danielle Leung is a **board-certified pediatrician who is a native of Texas**. She received her
undergraduate education at Austin College in Sherman, then completed her medical studies at **UT
Southwestern Medical Center** in Dallas. Her residency training was completed at Cardinal Glennon
Children’s Hospital in St. Louis. Since completing her studies and training, she has worked in
private practice and pediatric urgent care. Recently, she decided to return to the private medical
practice and establish Entirely Kids Pediatrics in Frisco, TX. She is proficient in medical Spanish,
Cantonese and Mandarin Chinese. Dr. Leung currently lives with her husband and two sons. She enjoys
traveling, cooking, baking, yoga, and reading in her spare time.

[Karen Cheng]

Dr. Karen Cheng is a ***board certified general pediatrician from the DFW area***. She attended the
University of Texas at Dallas for her undergraduate studies and then received her osteopathic
medical degree from **Kansas City University**. Dr. Cheng went on to complete her pediatric
residency at Oklahoma Children’s Hospital in Oklahoma City. She practiced as a general pediatrician
in Oklahoma City before recently moving back to Texas with hopes to serve the DFW community in which
she grew up. Dr. Cheng speaks English and Vietnamese. In her spare time, Dr. Cheng enjoys spending
time with her husband, son, and dog by exploring new cuisines, hiking near and far, and traveling to
visit different national parks.

## FAQs

#### Do you take walk-in visits?

No, we currently DO NOT take walk-ins. However, we do our very best to give same-day visits
depending on the physicians schedule that day but it must be made in advanced. All visits must be
scheduled IN ADVANCE!

If your child has an urgent matter that requires immediate attention, we would recommend you go to
the nearest

👉 [Children's Hospital of Orange County Emergency Room][96]

👉 [Pomona Valley Medical Center Emergency Room][97]

#### I have a school form (ie. medicines, allergies, sports physical, annual physical) to be
#### completed. How can I get that done?

Drop off the form to one of our staff members during normal office hours and we will have it
completed it for you WITHIN 3-5 business day. Most forms will require a form fee of $35 for our
administrative time. If you need it rushed, there is a rush fee of $10.

You can either pick it up in person or the completed form can be e-mailed to you.

#### What is the best way to schedule an appointment with your office?

You can schedule an appointment by

1) Requesting an appointment through your [**patient portal**][98]

2) Submitting a request online [**HERE**][99]

3) Calling our office during regular [**business hours**][100]

#### Is your office accepting new patients?

Yes, we are accepting new patients. Please complete the new patient registration form
[**HERE**][101] and one of our staff will check insurance eligibility before contacting you back to
schedule an appointment.

## FAQs

#### Do you take walk-in visits?

No, we currently DO NOT take walk-ins. However, we do our very best to give same-day visits
depending on the physicians schedule that day but it must be made in advanced. All visits must be
scheduled IN ADVANCE!

If your child has an urgent matter that requires immediate attention, we would recommend you go to
the nearest

👉 [Children's Hospital of Orange County Emergency Room][96]

👉 [Pomona Valley Medical Center Emergency Room][97]

#### I have a school form (ie. medicines, allergies, sports physical, annual physical) to be
#### completed. How can I get that done?

Drop off the form to one of our staff members during normal office hours and we will have it
completed it for you WITHIN 3-5 business day. Most forms will require a form fee of $35 for our
administrative time. If you need it rushed, there is a rush fee of $10.

You can either pick it up in person or the completed form can be e-mailed to you.

#### What is the best way to schedule an appointment with your office?

You can schedule an appointment by

1) Requesting an appointment through your [**patient portal**][98]

2) Submitting a request online [**HERE**][99]

3) Calling our office during regular [**business hours**][100]

#### Is your office accepting new patients?

Yes, we are accepting new patients. Please complete the new patient registration form
[**HERE**][101] and one of our staff will check insurance eligibility before contacting you back to
schedule an appointment.

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

[devices-osirix]

With high performance and an intuitive interactive user interface, OsiriX is the most widely used
DICOM viewer in the world. It is the result of more than 20 years of research and development in
digital imaging. It fully supports the DICOM standard for an easy integration in your workflow
environment and an open platform for development of processing tools. It offers advanced
post-processing techniques in 2D and 3D, exclusive innovative technique for 3D and 4D navigation and
a complete integration with any PACS. OsiriX supports 64-bit computing and multithreading for the
best performances on the most modern processors. OsiriX MD, the commercial version, is certified for
medical use (FDA cleared and CE II labeled).

## [ABOUT US][16]

## The Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation (RILSF) provides assistance to visually impaired persons 
## in our Rhode Island communities.
## The RILSF is composed of representatives from Lions clubs around Rhode Island. The assistance we
## provide can be financial, material, social and developmental.
##  
## The Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation was founded in 1961 as a charitable arm of the Lions
## Clubs International, District 42.
##  
## The Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation is a 501 C-3 non-profit organization.

## [RECENT EVENTS][34]

[2026_RI_VIPFishingTornament.JPG]

### [2026  19th Annual RI VIP Fishing Tournament][35]

The 19th RI VIP Fishing Tournament was held on June 26th and was very successful. The weather was
good and the seas calm .

[group shot.jfif]

### [Camp Mauchatea 2026  Winter  Camp][36]

Camp Mauchatea Winter Camp was a great  success! Campers stayed at the Great Wolf Lodge in
Mashantucket, CT, and went swimming, and on ropes courses and  water slides, played golf, and
snooker as well as going in the hot tub plus eating great food. 

[RILSF vision screeners at a RI school]

### [SCHOOL YEAR 2025-2026  VISION SCREENING][37]

The RILSF and local RI Lions clubs helped with vision pre-screening of preschool, elementary, middle
(7th grade),  and high school students (9th grade) through out RI. 

Over 37,661 students at  180 schools in RI were screened  by the RI Lions Sight Foundation and local
RI Lions clubs in the 2025-2026  school year.  

### [2025  2nd Annual Golf Tournament][38]

The Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation held its 2nd Annual VIP Golf Tournament on October 25, 2025,
at Top Golf in Cranston, RI. VIPS and sighted golfers could  have breakfast, play golf, and
participate in the raffle held.

[Packing eye glasses to be sent to Lions Eyeglass Recycling Center]

### [Annual Eye Glass Collection Event][39]

 On May 16, 2024, over 30 Lions from various Rhode Island Lions Cubs, in addition to a North
Smithfield High School student, packed about  16,000 pairs of eyeglasses to be sent to the New
Jersey Lions Eye Glass Recycling Center. There the eyeglass lens powers are measured and then the
eyeglasses are catalogued by lens power. They can be shipped to missions that provide eyecare for
communities around the world that do not have good eye care. 
Thank you to the Sunnyside Restaurant for letting the RILSF use their space for this event and their
help with the shipping. 
 

## DONATE

The RI Lions Sight Foundation is a 501 C-3 non-profit dedicated to helping visually impaired people
living in RI

The RI Lions Sight Foundation accepts donations to support our programs for helping visually
impaired persons in Rhode Island. Funds collected support the camps we run for visually impaired
children as well as providing eye exams and glasses to those who need financial help, recreational
programs like the fishing tournament and rowing program,  and helping perform vision screening in RI
schools.

Donations by check can be sent to

## [ABOUT US][16]

## The Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation (RILSF) provides assistance to visually impaired persons 
## in our Rhode Island communities.
## The RILSF is composed of representatives from Lions clubs around Rhode Island. The assistance we
## provide can be financial, material, social and developmental.
##  
## The Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation was founded in 1961 as a charitable arm of the Lions
## Clubs International, District 42.
##  
## The Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation is a 501 C-3 non-profit organization.

## [RECENT EVENTS][34]

[2026_RI_VIPFishingTornament.JPG]

### [2026  19th Annual RI VIP Fishing Tournament][35]

The 19th RI VIP Fishing Tournament was held on June 26th and was very successful. The weather was
good and the seas calm .

[group shot.jfif]

### [Camp Mauchatea 2026  Winter  Camp][36]

Camp Mauchatea Winter Camp was a great  success! Campers stayed at the Great Wolf Lodge in
Mashantucket, CT, and went swimming, and on ropes courses and  water slides, played golf, and
snooker as well as going in the hot tub plus eating great food. 

[RILSF vision screeners at a RI school]

### [SCHOOL YEAR 2025-2026  VISION SCREENING][37]

The RILSF and local RI Lions clubs helped with vision pre-screening of preschool, elementary, middle
(7th grade),  and high school students (9th grade) through out RI. 

Over 37,661 students at  180 schools in RI were screened  by the RI Lions Sight Foundation and local
RI Lions clubs in the 2025-2026  school year.  

### [2025  2nd Annual Golf Tournament][38]

The Rhode Island Lions Sight Foundation held its 2nd Annual VIP Golf Tournament on October 25, 2025,
at Top Golf in Cranston, RI. VIPS and sighted golfers could  have breakfast, play golf, and
participate in the raffle held.

[Packing eye glasses to be sent to Lions Eyeglass Recycling Center]

### [Annual Eye Glass Collection Event][39]

 On May 16, 2024, over 30 Lions from various Rhode Island Lions Cubs, in addition to a North
Smithfield High School student, packed about  16,000 pairs of eyeglasses to be sent to the New
Jersey Lions Eye Glass Recycling Center. There the eyeglass lens powers are measured and then the
eyeglasses are catalogued by lens power. They can be shipped to missions that provide eyecare for
communities around the world that do not have good eye care. 
Thank you to the Sunnyside Restaurant for letting the RILSF use their space for this event and their
help with the shipping.

The RI Lions Sight Foundation is a 501 C-3 non-profit dedicated to helping visually impaired people
living in RI

The RI Lions Sight Foundation accepts donations to support our programs for helping visually
impaired persons in Rhode Island. Funds collected support the camps we run for visually impaired
children as well as providing eye exams and glasses to those who need financial help, recreational
programs like the fishing tournament and rowing program,  and helping perform vision screening in RI
schools.

assessment, TTAC (pronounced “tea-tac”) aims to become the place for answers to questions about
selecting appropriate technologies for your telehealth program. [More information >][20]

#### FEATURED ITEMS

**[Meet the Team][27]**
**[Electronic Stethoscope Toolkit][28]**

Electronic stethoscopes enhance traditional auscultation by amplifying body sounds and converting
them into digital signals that can be heard locally, stored for later review, or transmitted live
during telehealth visits. This makes them especially valuable in remote care, where clinicians can
assess heart, lung, and other sounds in real time or asynchronously.

**[Clinician’s Guide to Video Platforms][29]**

Why This Guide Matters

While audio-only visits expanded access during the COVID-19 public health emergency, video remains
the dominant format for telehealth encounters nationwide. Video enables visual assessment, nonverbal
communication, and stronger clinical context—elements that are essential for quality care but highly
sensitive to technology performance.

**[Electronic Stethoscope Toolkit][28]**

Electronic stethoscopes enhance traditional auscultation by amplifying body sounds and converting
them into digital signals that can be heard locally, stored for later review, or transmitted live
during telehealth visits. This makes them especially valuable in remote care, where clinicians can
assess heart, lung, and other sounds in real time or asynchronously.

**[Clinician’s Guide to Video Platforms][29]**

Why This Guide Matters

While audio-only visits expanded access during the COVID-19 public health emergency, video remains
the dominant format for telehealth encounters nationwide. Video enables visual assessment, nonverbal
communication, and stronger clinical context—elements that are essential for quality care but highly
sensitive to technology performance.

Coverage; this coupled with a start-up drive to excel, and a constant focus on values, provides an
unparalleled experience to our clients.
